data.name: Mixing-chamber heater
data.function: Resistor on the mixing-chamber plate used to regulate the base temperature above its natural minimum, to measure the cooling-power curve (applied power versus resulting temperature), and to warm the sample stage deliberately, for example to measure the temperature dependence of qubit coherence or resonator loss.

physics.summary: Applies a known heat load for temperature regulation and cooling-power measurements.

data.tooltip: Mixing-chamber heater for regulation and cooling-power curves.
